items.title: Moving to Canada as a Software Developer: Express Entry for Devs (2026)
items.pt:
If you write software and are looking at Canada, Express Entry is probably the first thing you found. It is a sensible start: tech roles are skilled occupations, and you do not need a job offer to apply.

But a lot of what you will read online is out of date. Two changes matter for developers: job offers no longer add points to your Express Entry score, and the main software roles are not on IRCC's 2026 STEM category list.

This walkthrough reflects the rules as of October 2026. It is not legal

items.title: Distilling Graph Geometry: Knowledge Gap from GNNs to MLPs
items.pt: GNN-to-MLP distillation aims to retain the predictive accuracy of a message-passing teacher while deploying a graph-free MLP at inference. Existing methods mainly transfer node-wise predictions or use confidence-based reweighting, but they do not specify where the student should preserve the teacher's graph-induced geometry. We show that this omission leads to two spectral failure modes in the student's representation space. On sparse graphs, the student suffers from spectral underfit, missing h

items.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models

items.title: SciExam for ENSO: Can AI Agents Build Climate Models?
items.pt: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out open-ended scientific research, yet their results are usually graded against a known answer, a rubric, or a language-model reviewer, none of which can tell whether a new scientific model is valid. items.title: Video-Conditioned Generative Joint 2D-3D Hand Motion Recovery
items.pt: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent. To address this problem, we propose JoHan, a unified generative framework that recovers hand motion directly from video sequences without relying on intermediate per-frame pose predictions.
